Tests for {@link PosixParser} focusing on the short-option-with-equals syntax (e.g. {@code -f=bar}).

PosixParser does not support the {@code -f=bar} form for short options; the equals sign is treated as part of the option argument rather than a separator. The inherited {@code testShortWithEqual} test is therefore disabled for this parser.
Initialises the parser under test with a {@link PosixParser} instance before each test.
PosixParser does not recognise the equals sign as an argument separator for short options, so this test is disabled. Use {@link DefaultParser} for short-option-with-equals support.
